question: In which of the following liquids would anthracene dissolve easily?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Benzene**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anthracene** is a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon.
 
• It is **non-polar** in nature.
 
• According to the principle of **"like dissolves like"**, non-polar solutes dissolve well in non-polar solvents.
 
• **Benzene** is a non-polar solvent.
 
• Therefore, **anthracene** would dissolve easily in **benzene**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Water** is a polar solvent and would not dissolve non-polar substances like anthracene well.
 
• **Methane** is a gas at room temperature and is not used as a solvent for dissolving solids.
 
• **Sodium chloride** is an ionic compound and would not dissolve non-polar substances like anthracene.
 
• Choosing the appropriate solvent is crucial in chemical processes and experiments to ensure proper dissolution and reaction.
